theme_and_identity.core_concept: Tactical Minimalism. A high-performance command center for a football club's medical department. Flat solid surfaces (no glass) to ensure data clarity.
theme_and_identity.primary_colors: CD Trofense Green, White, Obsidian Black.

headings.usage: H1-H4, Player Names, KPI Numbers. Use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for a compact, athletic look.

body.usage: Tables, labels, standard text. Clinical legibility for medical data.

grids.dashboard: Grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4. High Density for data bento grids. Every pixel utilized.
grids.forms: Dense 2-column or 3-column grids for skinfolds (pregas cutâneas) and circumferences (perímetros).

layouts.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-6, p-8) for macro-layout (sections, page wrappers). High Density (tight gap-4) inside data cards.
layouts.structure: Fixed left sidebar (250px) + Main content area. F-Pattern layout where critical KPIs (Weight, Fat %, Muscle Mass) sit top-left.
layouts.surfaces: Flat Solid (No Glassmorphism). Medical apps require sharp, non-refracting data containers. 1px solid borders.

components.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar. High contrast (Dark surface even in light mode, or inverse). Use Phosphor Icons. Include Trofense Green accents on active states.
components.athlete_card: Horizontal split. Left: Photo + basic info. Right: Bento grid of KPIs (IMC, Fat %, Muscle Mass) and status pills.
components.evaluation_form: Dense grid for inputs. Results section sticks to the right or bottom and updates in real-time.
components.charts: Recharts. Use semantic green/red lines. Neon green for lean mass, red for fat mass. Include tooltips with comparison between methods.
components.photo_timeline: Lado-a-lado (side-by-side) slider or scrollable timeline of frontal/profile/back photos.
components.status_pills: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) badges with semantic coloring: Ótimo (Green), Atenção (Yellow), Alto (Red).

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border (border-border). No soft shadows, use crisp 2px inner shadows or flat design to reinforce the 'Tactical Minimalism' vibe.
visual_enhancers.charts: Recharts with Trofense green primary line. Dark mode uses bright neon green (#10B981) for visibility.

motion.interactions: Micro-interactions on hover (bg shifts, slight border darkening).
motion.loading: Skeleton loaders for fetching athlete data to prevent layout shift.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for all medical data text. Text over colored pills must meet 3:1.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST use data-testid. E.g., data-testid='eval-form-submit', data-testid='athlete-row-1'.

media.images: Use B/W and high-contrast fitness portraits to elevate the athletic aesthetic.

3d_libraries.usage: Not recommended for this clinical dashboard. Focus on 2D Recharts for precise data visualization.

athlete_portrait.description: B/W athlete portrait for profile header.

medical_clinic.description: Physio/Medical background for login screen or auth pages.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard layout with a fixed sidebar and a top header containing a Dark Mode toggle.
For typography, import 'Barlow Condensed' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts.
Use Shadcn UI components for Tabs, Forms, Select, and Dialogs. Ensure they are styled flat (no heavy drop shadows) to match the clinical/athletic vibe.
Implement the Anthropometric Evaluation Form using React Hook Form, calculating Body Fat % (Reilly & Wallace, Evans 2005, Jackson-Pollock, Withers) and Muscle Mass (Lee 2000) dynamically.
For charts, use Recharts (`ResponsiveContainer`, `LineChart`, `AreaChart`). Style the lines with the provided primary colors.
In the charts for daily weigh-ins (Pesagens diárias), include a calculated Moving Average (média móvel) line.
Include export functionality buttons: 'Exportar Excel', 'Backup JSON', and 'Gerar HTML' in the athlete report header.
Incorporate the provided status pills (Ótimo, Atenção, Alto) based on Body Fat % logic.
Ensure the layout is responsive, especially for tablet (iPad) usage in the gym (large touch targets, readable fonts).
Add data-testid attributes to ALL interactive elements and KPIs.
Ensure all text is in Portuguese (PT-PT).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients. Create depth through layered flat design (borders).
Medical/sports apps must be highly functional. Avoid glassmorphism to prevent data refraction. Use solid backgrounds.
Never apply 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions (e.g., 'transition-colors').
Never use AI emoji placeholders. Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide.
Ensure hover states and focus rings are distinct and accessible.
Use sonner for toast notifications (e.g., 'Avaliação guardada com sucesso').
Provide empty states with skeleton loaders while fetching.
